search_objective: Identify authoritative sources reporting Measles cases, deaths, hospitalizations, and subnational locations in the United States for the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-03-31, covering CDC surveillance pages, WHO/PAHO international reports, structured outbreak databases, and news/situation reports.
search_reasoning: The upstream plan covers the right source-type spectrum (official agency, international org, structured database, news) but uses overly rigid quoted-phrase constructions that may suppress relevant results (e.g., CDC pages rarely use the exact phrase "measles cases United States 2025" in their own text). For iteration 1 we are capped at 4 queries, so we must prioritise the highest-yield channels: (1) CDC official surveillance — the primary authoritative source for US measles counts; (2) WHO/PAHO international situation reports — cross-validates national figures and may carry subnational breakdowns; (3) a structured/database query targeting ProMED, HealthMap, or CDC NNDSS data exports; (4) a news/media query to surface state-level outbreak reports and hospitalization details that official pages may lag. Queries are rewritten to remove over-restrictive exact-phrase quoting, add CDC-specific terminology ("MMWR", "NNDSS", "measles surveillance"), and include state-level outbreak terms (Texas, Ohio, etc.) that were active in early 2025. The literature channel (peer-reviewed) is deferred to iteration 2 because Q1 2025 papers are unlikely to be indexed yet. Language is English only — US context requires no localization.

query_batch.query: CDC measles cases United States 2025 surveillance NNDSS MMWR outbreak confirmed deaths hospitalizations
query_batch.query_rationale: Targets CDC's own measles surveillance pages, NNDSS data tables, and MMWR reports — the highest-authority source for US national case counts, deaths, and hospitalizations in Q1 2025. Relaxes exact-phrase quoting from upstream plan to avoid suppressing CDC page titles that use different phrasing. Adds 'NNDSS' and 'MMWR' as CDC-specific terminology to surface the most data-rich pages.
query_batch.expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC.gov measles surveillance summary, MMWR report, or NNDSS data table with 2025 case counts
query_batch.expected_trust_signal: CDC.gov domain; MMWR publication; official surveillance data table with weekly or cumulative totals

query_batch.query: measles outbreak United States 2025 state cases deaths Texas Ohio site:who.int OR site:paho.org OR PAHO AMRO epidemiological alert
query_batch.query_rationale: Targets WHO Disease Outbreak News and PAHO/AMRO epidemiological alerts for the Americas, which cross-validate CDC national figures and may include subnational breakdowns. Adds state names (Texas, Ohio) reflecting known early-2025 US outbreak concentrations. Refines upstream q_exec_003/004 by removing over-quoted phrases and adding international org domain signals.
query_batch.expected_source_type_or_evidence: WHO Disease Outbreak News entry or PAHO epidemiological update referencing US measles cases in 2025
query_batch.expected_trust_signal: WHO.int or PAHO.org domain; official situation report with case count table and reporting date

query_batch.query: measles 2025 United States outbreak cases confirmed state health department ProMED HealthMap January February March
query_batch.query_rationale: Targets structured outbreak alert databases (ProMED-mail, HealthMap) and state health department press releases that carry subnational location, date, and case-count fields. These sources often report faster than CDC surveillance summaries and can surface locality-level data. Refines upstream q_exec_007/008 by removing exact-phrase quoting and adding ProMED/HealthMap as explicit signal terms.
query_batch.expected_source_type_or_evidence: ProMED-mail alert or HealthMap event record with US state, case count, and date; or state health department outbreak announcement
query_batch.expected_trust_signal: ProMED.org or HealthMap.org structured alert; state .gov health department press release with official case count

query_batch.query: measles outbreak 2025 United States cases deaths hospitalizations state confirmed unvaccinated January March
query_batch.query_rationale: Targets reputable news coverage (AP, Reuters, NPR, local outlets) that cites official case counts with subnational location, date, and hospitalization details. News sources often surface state-level outbreak data before CDC surveillance summaries are updated. Adds 'unvaccinated' as a common contextual term in measles outbreak reporting to improve precision. Refines upstream q_exec_009/010 by removing over-quoted phrases and broadening temporal terms.
query_batch.expected_source_type_or_evidence: News article from AP, Reuters, NPR, or local outlet citing official case counts, state location, and reporting date for Q1 2025
query_batch.expected_trust_signal: Bylined article from established outlet citing named official or health department; includes specific case count and date

CDC, state health departments, WHO AMRO/PAHO, and major news outlets all publish in English for this jurisdiction. No Spanish-language queries are needed at this stage (PAHO publishes English editions of all relevant reports).

WHO.int and PAHO.org are authoritative for international cross-validation
MMWR articles carry peer-review-equivalent authority for surveillance data
News sources acceptable only when they cite official figures with direct quotes and dates

stop_condition_hypothesis: Stop after iteration 1 if results include: (a) a CDC surveillance summary with national case counts for Q1 2025, (b) at least one WHO or PAHO report cross-referencing US measles data, and (c) at least two subnational (state-level) outbreak reports with case counts and dates. Otherwise proceed to iteration 2 for refinement and literature coverage.
warnings: Upstream queries use over-restrictive exact-phrase quoting that may miss CDC page titles and MMWR abstracts — rewritten queries relax this
Q1 2025 is recent; peer-reviewed literature is unlikely to be indexed yet — literature channel deferred to iteration 2

Max 4 queries this iteration — channels prioritised by expected yield: CDC official > international org > structured DB > news

search_reasoning: Iteration 1 produced strong foundational coverage: the MMWR report (mm7414a1) confirms 800 cases through April 17, 2025 with deaths (3) and hospitalizations (85), and the MSK library guide provides county-level Texas/Oklahoma/Maryland case detail for Q1 2025. However, several gaps remain for the strict 2025-01-01 to 2025-03-31 window: (1) No WHO/PAHO situation report or Disease Outbreak News entry was returned — the international cross-validation source is missing. (2) State health department primary sources for Texas (DSHS), New Mexico (NMDOH), and Oklahoma (OSDH) were not directly surfaced — the MSK guide references them but they are not primary candidates. (3) The MMWR report covers through April 17, not just Q1; we need earlier MMWR early-release or CDC situation report specifically covering January–March 2025 to isolate Q1 figures. (4) No ProMED or CIDRAP structured alert with dated subnational case counts appeared in the accepted set (cidrap.umn.edu appeared but no snippet was shown). (5) The arcgis.com dashboard aggregates 2025+2026 combined — not Q1-specific. Iteration 2 should target: (a) state health department primary pages for TX/NM/OK; (b) WHO PAHO AMRO epidemiological alert for the Americas Q1 2025; (c) earlier MMWR early-release or CDC situation report for January–March 2025 specifically; (d) CIDRAP and ProMED structured alerts with Q1 2025 dates.

query_batch.query: Texas DSHS measles outbreak 2025 confirmed cases Gaines County West Texas January February March site:dshs.texas.gov OR site:hhs.texas.gov
query_batch.query_rationale: Texas DSHS is the primary authoritative source for the West Texas measles outbreak that drove the majority of Q1 2025 US cases. The MSK guide references Gaines County and Lubbock — DSHS situation reports or press releases should provide primary case counts, dates, and hospitalization figures for January–March 2025. Domain-limited to dshs.texas.gov and hhs.texas.gov to maximise authority.
query_batch.expected_source_type_or_evidence: DSHS Texas press release or situation report with confirmed case count, county-level breakdown, and reporting date for Q1 2025
query_batch.expected_trust_signal: dshs.texas.gov or hhs.texas.gov domain; official press release with named spokesperson or case count table
query_batch.previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q3 — state health department channel; MSK guide referenced DSHS TX as primary source

This query targets NMDOH situation reports and press releases for Q1 2025.

query_batch.expected_trust_signal: nmhealth.org domain; official press release with case count and reporting date

query_batch.expected_trust_signal: paho.org or who.int domain; official situation report with case count table and reporting date
